achievements.description: Reach the PEAK.
achievements.hint: PEAK is the final biome of PEAK. You only need to reach it.

achievements.description: Cook 20 meals at campfires.
achievements.hint: Can be done in multiple expeditions. Item doesn't have to be safe nor edible, meaning you can just cook a medkit or a backpack. Because of this, you can use the SHORE's initial fire to cook all the stuff you see if you want.

achievements.description: Place 100m of rope in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: Rope Spools have 12.5m of rope meanwhile Rope Cannons have 7.5m of rope. You can mix and match both, of course.

achievements.description: Climb past the SHORE.
achievements.hint: "SHORE" will always be the first biome you encounter regardless of the map's seed.

achievements.description: Have a friend escape the island without you.
achievements.hint: At the peak, before the helicopter countdown ends, have someone be a ghost. As soon as the ending cutscene starts, the player that died will get the achievement.

achievements.description: Climb past the TROPICS.
achievements.hint: "TROPICS" can be the second biome you encounter. It can sometimes be replaced by "ROOTS", depending on the map's seed.

achievements.description: Receive 5 Morale Boosts from campfires.
achievements.hint: Can be done in multiple expeditions but a single full run should be enough.

achievements.description: Climb past the ALPINE.
achievements.hint: "ALPINE" can be the third biome you encounter. It can sometimes be replaced by "MESA", depending on the map's seed.

achievements.description: Climb past the CALDERA.
achievements.hint: "CALDERA" is the penultimate biome before the Peak. It can sometimes be replaced by "GLOOM", depending on the map's seed.

achievements.description: Place 10 pitons.
achievements.hint: You can find pitons inside luggage cases. Just place em!

achievements.description: Restore 200 total poison by using items.
achievements.hint: The items that cure poison are Antidote, Cure-All, First Aid Kit and Medicinal Root. Can be done in multiple expeditions.

achievements.description: Eat 5 different berries in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: Any item whose name ends in "berry" or "berries" count, meaning the apple-looking berries from SHORE, the Scorchberries from ALPINE, the banana/durian-looking berries from TROPICS and the Shroomberries from ROOTS do work. These don't have to be cooked nor safe to eat for the achievement to pop up.

achievements.description: Obtain a mystical item.
achievements.hint: Obtained from Ancient Luggage (for 20 Injury damage) or Ancient Statue (if no one dies). The Amulets also do count.

achievements.description: Escape the island in a solo expedition.
achievements.hint: Win a solo round. Good luck!

achievements.description: Resurrect 3 scouts in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: The same person can be resurrected multiple times. To do so, when your teammate is dead, interact with the statue at each biome's campfire.

achievements.description: Escape the island without taking fall damage.
achievements.hint: There's no way to cheese this, you need 0 fall damage. You can get Injury damage from other sources tho, just not Fall Damage.

achievements.description: Escape the island without placing anything on the mountain.
achievements.hint: The only items you can use are the Shelf Fungus, Cloud Fungus, Magic Bean, and Rescue Claw, Anti-Zooka and of course the Scout Amulets.

achievements.description: Escape the island in under an hour.
achievements.hint: If you're unable to do this, ask a friend! You don't have to be alive for the achievement to pop.

achievements.description: Help Bing Bong escape the island.
achievements.hint: Bing Bong is the plushie found at the beginning of the game.

achievements.description: Escape the island without eating any packaged food.
achievements.hint: Contrary to what you might think, Marshmallows, Hot-dogs and Pandora's Lunchbox don't count as "packaged food".

achievements.description: Escape the island after cooking and eating a coconut half, a honeycomb, a yellow winterberry, and an egg.
achievements.hint: You obtain coconuts at the SHORE, Honeycomb on TROPICS or ROOTS, the Yellow Winterberry at the ALPINE (check the capybaras for a 100% spawn chance!) and the Egg in either GLOOM or CALDERA. Cook these items as many times as you want, eat them and escape the island for the achievement.

achievements.description: Eat four different non-toxic mushrooms in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: Can be done as early as SHORE and continued in TROPICS and ROOTS, but if you get Roots instead, do note that Shroomberries don't count towards the achievement.

achievements.description: Heal your friends for 100 points of injury in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: Any proximity based item (Faerie Lantern, Remedy Fungus) doesn't count, you need to interact with your teammate with an item that heals injury when they are injured.

achievements.description: Escape the island without ever losing consciousness.
achievements.hint: If you didn't die but lost consciousness at least once, you'll be disqualified for this badge.

achievements.description: Play the bugle for a capybara.
achievements.hint: Bring the Bugle from the "SHORE"'s airplane and in either "ALPINE" or "MESA", The Capybara can be found taking a bath.

achievements.description: Reach the top of a really big tree.
achievements.hint: Easier to do in TROPICS.

achievements.description: Have a 1-on-1 with the Scoutmaster.
achievements.hint: If you're 160m ahead of your teammate(s), the Scoutmaster will spawn after 30 seconds. If solo, use the Scoutmaster's Bugle to spawn the Scoutmaster. The bugle can be found in an Ancient Statue/Luggage when playing solo.

achievements.description: Heal an unconscious friend with an item to save them from death.
achievements.hint: When someone gets unconscious, interact with them using an item that can heal what they need (hunger, injury, drowsyness, etc.)

achievements.description: Climb 5000m total.
achievements.hint: Can be done in multiple expeditions. For reference, A single expedition is around 1900m.

achievements.description: Open 15 luggages in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: For the sake of your teammates please try to do this solo. Regardless, do note that the "Pirate Compass", a compass that shows you where luggage is, is obtainable inside luggages.

achievements.description: Read the Scoutmaster’s final journal entry.
achievements.hint: At biome's campfires you'll find a scroll. Open it up and read it (zoom) for it to count towards the badge. If someone else opened it, just have them give you the page and you read it. If you open it, it'll prioritize giving you the one's you're missing.

achievements.description: Climb 50m upwards without touching the ground.
achievements.hint: Set up a string of ropes (around 5+ of them) and climb up! Do note that using pitons will count as touching the ground so

achievements.description: Climb past the MESA.
achievements.hint: "MESA" can be the third biome you encounter. It can sometimes be replaced by "ALPINE", depending on the map's seed.

achievements.description: Catch a Flying Disc from 100m away.
achievements.hint: Easier done at the campfire of any biome, since you can see the exact distance at which the other player is at. The Flying Disc can be found at the SHORE's airplane crash.

achievements.description: Climb past the MESA without ever having more than 10% Heat.
achievements.hint: While the ALPINE temperature achievement has a 20% requirement, The Mesa is 10% which is a lot tighter so make sure you're using either a Glider or a Parasol to block the sun. You'll get the achievement after you lit the biome's campfire.

achievements.description: Have a lot of cactuses stuck to you.
achievements.hint: This doesn't work with tall Cacti like the one in the image, but rather the ones you can pick up and throw. Having a clean stamina bar, get as many of those little Cacti on you and when you're starting to faint, take them off you.

achievements.description: Achieve flight.
achievements.hint: Obtain 6 balloons and use them together to be able to fly.

achievements.description: Offer The Kiln a worthy sacrifice.
achievements.hint: To get the "worthy sacrifice" you must first find the MESA's Tomb and get the loot. Carry it all the way to the Kiln/Citadel and then throw it into the lava. Do note that while the Tomb always appears, it is not guaranteed to be accessible on a given Mesa map.

achievements.description: Give in to your hunger.
achievements.hint: In multiplayer and with Cannibalism enabled in the Accesibility options, when reaching 70% hunger you'll be able to eat another Scout. If solo, disable cannibalism and hope that the eggs in GLOOM or CALDERA give you a Cooked Bird (10% chance from Big Eggs and 1% from Small Eggs when breaking).

achievements.description: Shoot across the MESA canyon in a Scout Cannon.
achievements.hint: Halfway through the MESA you'll find a Canyon. If you use a Scout Cannon to get launched to the other side of the Canyon, you'll get the Badge.

achievements.description: Survive an Antlion attack.
achievements.hint: In MESA, get hit by an Antlion at least once and then run away. This can be done with any immunity-granting item like the Fortified Milk.

achievements.description: Look a little too closely at the blazing sun.
achievements.hint: With the Binoculars, Look at the MESA's sun. You can get binoculars from the SHORE's airplane or randomly inside a luggage.

achievements.description: Climb past the ALPINE without ever having more than 20% Cold.
achievements.hint:
I recommend bringing the Lantern from the SHORE's airplane crash. Pair that with the occasional Heat Pack found in ALPINE's luggage cases.
Do note that unlike MESA's temperature badge, ALPINE requires having less than 20% temperature, instead of 10%. You'll get the achievement after you lit the biome's campfire.

achievements.description: Climb past the ROOTS.
achievements.hint: "ROOTS" can be the second biome you encounter. It can sometimes be replaced by "TROPICS", depending on the map's seed.

achievements.description: Climb past the ROOTS without ever having more than 25% spores.
Escape a spider's web and survive.
achievements.hint: In Roots, you can see spiders hanging from trees. Get grabbed by one and then get ready to mash spacebar!

achievements.description: Cure yourself from a zombie bite.
achievements.hint: In Roots, Get bitten by a zombie then reduce your spores to 0 with any poison/injury healing item.

achievements.description: Try all 5 types of Shroomberry in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: Since Shroomberrys are berries, you can find these in vines, trees, plants and sometimes the ground. There are 6 types of Shroomberry: Red, Yellow, Green, Blue and Purple. Warm colors (Red and Yellow) are always good meanwhile Purple's effect is random. Green and Blue berries are of course bad.

achievements.description: Pull an unconscious friend 30m with the Rescue Claw.
achievements.hint: The Rescue Claw's max range is 48m so use that as a reference point on how far you have to be to get the achievement.

achievements.description: Block 100 total damage with the Fortified Milk.
achievements.hint: Anything that can affect your stamina bar (besides weight and petrification) will count as damage that can be blocked. Easiest way to get this is jumping off from a biome's campfire to a place with lethal damage and then drinking the milk before hitting the ground/while falling. You might need to do this more than once so feel free to clone it with the Scout's Generosity amulet!

achievements.description: Eat 3 Hot Dogs in 5 seconds or less.
achievements.hint: Hot dogs have a chance to replace Marshmallows at each campfire, as well as Cat Tails in GLOOM. It's the only place they spawn so you might have to carry some to the next campfire or use Scout's Generosity to duplicate them. They don't have to be cooked to obtain the achievement.

achievements.description: Resurrect a friend using unholy means.
achievements.hint: Use the Book of Bones on a dead player's skeleton.

achievements.description: Bounce up 40m off a mushroom.
achievements.hint: To bounce 40m off a mushroom you can either jump from very high and land on a mushroom or attach some balloons or even use a rescue claw to get it!

achievements.description: Cook and eat a Mandrake.
achievements.hint: Mandrakes have a 50% chance of replacing Medicinal Roots in the Roots biome. When plucked, Mandrakes will scream and inflict Drowsy in a big area. There are multiple ways of dealing with a Mandrake's drowsy. One is by setting your master volume to 0 (I know it sounds like bs but it does work) or bring a portable stove or attempt only as a skeleton.

achievements.description: Climb past the GLOOM.
achievements.hint: "GLOOM" is the penultimate biome before the Peak. It can sometimes be replaced by "CALDERA", depending on the map's seed.

achievements.description: Ring 5 Belltowers in the GLOOM in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: There can be more than 5 Belltowers in each "GLOOM" biome. The statues *DON'T* point towards the belltowers but towards luggage. Your best way of locating these is by following crow calls. I recommend bringing a way to exorcise the ghost, although do note that the ghost won't die forever. The way I got it was by segmenting the gloom (from north to south) in 3 slices and just going on a straight light following any crow that would stay in the same slice. Good luck!

achievements.description: Consume The Early Worm.
achievements.hint: In "GLOOM", you'll find "The Early Worm" circling the bottom of most small mountains. There are multiple of them.

achievements.description: Open 2 Clown Luggage in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: Clown Luggage has a small chance of replacing any other luggage but it's probably the rarest kind of luggage, to the point where sometimes maps can have a total amount of 3 per map (yes, map, not biome).

achievements.description: Fly 100m with the Glider without touching the ground.
achievements.hint: An entire bar and a half of stamina is needed for this Once you get the Glider, equip it and jump away from the mountain. The safest way to ensure there's 100m is to do it at the start/end of a biome.

achievements.description: Climb past THE CITADEL without being hit by any traps.
achievements.hint: "THE CITADEL" can be the last biome before the Peak. It can sometimes be replaced by "THE KILN", depending on the map's seed. Complete this biome without being hit by any traps (petrification stone doesn't count)

achievements.description: Heal over 75% damage at once by using the Ritual Dagger.
achievements.hint: When more than 75% of your Stamina bar is affected by anything other than weight, use a Ritual Dagger to kill another player and thus heal yourself. The person that stabs is the person that gets the achievement.

achievements.description: Burn up the Ghost.
achievements.hint: In "GLOOM", light up a Belltower next to the ghost. Alternatively, you can exorcise the Ghost by using any of the following items: Candlestick, Faerie Lantern, Lantern, Portable Stove. NOTE: The Ghost doesn't stay dead forever once exorcised.

achievements.description: Remove 10 arrows from yourself in a single expedition.
achievements.hint: In "THE CITADEL", remove 10 arrows from yourself in the same run. This doesn't have to be all at once, just in the same run. Since each arrow trap shoots a maximum of 3 arrows, you will need to find 4 different arrow traps to get this achievement. I got hit with a single arrow while I was ascending and then got the rest when I was already at the top, just in case anything went wrong. Be sure to bring around 3 injury healing items.

Get the true ending. To do so: Obtain all 4 amulets from the Scout Statues then bring them behind the Peak and bestow them to the statue to transform a gem. Activate the Scout's Honor, commune with the soul and get to the top to escape.
